patterns.note: Expansive full-bleed hero and section imagery dominates the top of the page, transitioning to a clean, multi-column grid layout for product displays and information further down.
A single, clean sans-serif typeface is used consistently across all text elements, maintaining a sophisticated and highly readable aesthetic with generous line spacing.
The design relies on a minimalist palette of stark white backgrounds, deep charcoal text, and subtle light grey accents, creating a high-contrast, elegant visual hierarchy.
Sections are revealed with a subtle fade-up or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth content flow. The initial hero image features a gentle parallax effect on scroll.
Content sections are clearly delineated by ample vertical white space and often introduced by large, full-bleed photographic elements, giving each section a distinct visual weight.

technique_notes: Sections are revealed with a subtle fade-up or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth content flow. The initial hero image features a gentle parallax effect where the background image scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content. A full-screen modal is used for country selection, overlaying the page content with a semi-transparent backdrop.

design_tokens.type_scale: Balanced sans-serif type scale with clear hierarchy; headings are moderately larger than body text, maintaining readability and elegance.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, with very subtle rounding only on interactive elements like buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and generous vertical spacing between sections, creating a sense of calm and luxury; content within sections is balanced.

standout: The site's distinctive use of expansive white space and high-resolution product photography creates a luxurious, gallery-like experience. The design prioritizes visual elegance and product focus over dense information, making each watch feel like a piece of art.
